newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha flat with futures, demand still good.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha flat with futures, demand still good.

text.p: NWE naphtha moved sideways on Thursday as futures drifted, traders said.

An Irish player was heard having sold a small, light parcel to Antwerp but the price was not known. The buyer was also heard having bought 10,000 tonnes of light naphtha sourced from the U.K. on Wednesday at a fob price equivalent to cif high +$4-$5.
A Skikda cargo was traded on Wednesday at cif high +$4.50.

A small Russian piece was heard available this month, while another three were heard loading early next month. Shipping was tight and offers rose to around cif high +$2. Buyers were $3-$4 lower. -- Nicholas Shaxson, London newsroom +44 171 542 8167
